summary.zh: 悬停时按钮和整页背景一起亮起来：边上一道光绕圈扫过，三颗星依次弹一下，身后一圈小星星慢慢公转。
summary.en: On hover the button and the whole page light up together: a glint sweeps around the edge, three stars bounce in turn and a halo of tiny stars slowly orbits behind.

technique.zh: 一个变量 --active（0 / 1）驱动所有颜色、发光和缩放，body:has(button:hover) 让整页背景一起变。边缘光是 conic-gradient 以 steps(2) 翻面绕圈；粒子各自绕一个很远的 transform-origin 旋转，所以看起来是在漂。
technique.en: A single --active variable (0 / 1) drives every color, glow and scale; body:has(button:hover) brightens the whole page. The edge glint is a conic-gradient flipping round with steps(2); each particle rotates around a far-away transform-origin, so it seems to drift.

adapt.zh: AI 生成、升级、主行动按钮。整页变色比较“抢戏”，嵌在页面里时可以把 body:has 那条去掉。
adapt.en: AI “generate”, upgrade or primary CTAs. The full-page glow is loud; drop the body:has rule when embedding.
